byok.title: Your API keys
byok.description: Use your own provider keys. The copilot runs on your account, and your key unlocks that provider's models.
byok.invalid: That key couldn't be verified. Check that it's valid and try again.

primaryProvider.title: Primary provider
primaryProvider.description: When the same model is available through several of your keys, for example directly and through OpenRouter, this key runs it. A model you pick under Advanced runs on the key shown with it.
primaryProvider.saveFailed: Couldn't change the primary provider. Check your API keys and try again.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, or VS Code to your Knowtis notes.

connect.title: Connect with one click
connect.description: Add Knowtis as a connector in Claude, Cursor or VS Code. You sign in and approve — no keys to copy.
connect.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the URL. Copy it manually.
connect.step1: In Claude Desktop or claude.ai, open Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector.
connect.step2: Paste the URL above. Claude will ask you to sign in to Knowtis and approve access to read, edit and share your notes.
connect.step3: Claude warns that this is a third-party connector — that is expected. Approve to finish.

integrations.advancedDescription: For scripts, servers, or clients that can't open a browser. Most people should use the connector above instead.
integrations.revokeConfirm: Are you sure you want to revoke "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
integrations.keyCreatedWarning: Copy this key now. It won't be shown again.
integrations.emptyDescription: Create an API key to connect AI assistants to your notes.

read.label: Read only
read.description: View your notes and who they are shared with.

readWrite.label: Read and write
readWrite.description: Also create, edit and delete notes. Recommended.

readWriteShare.label: Read, write and share
readWriteShare.description: Also share your notes with other people.

connectedApps.title: Connected apps
connectedApps.description: Apps and AI assistants you authorized to access your notes with OAuth.
connectedApps.revokeConfirm: Revoke access for "{{name}}"? It will need to be authorized again to connect.
connectedApps.emptyDescription: Apps you authorize with OAuth will appear here.
connectedApps.errorDescription: Something went wrong loading your connected apps. Please try again.

memory.toggleHint: The copilot uses what it remembers in new chats and saves facts you share, like your role or how you like answers.
memory.paused: Memory is paused. The copilot keeps your saved memories but doesn't use them or save new ones. Chats you have while it's paused are never saved to memory, even after you turn it back on.
memory.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
memory.emptyDescription: As you chat, the copilot saves facts you share about yourself. They show up here.
memory.footnote: Deleting a conversation doesn't delete its memories.

withheld.explanation: The copilot doesn't use this memory because it has a link, an email address, code or text that reads like an instruction. Forget it to free up space.

errors.contentPolicy: Memories can't include links, email addresses, markup or code. Remove them and try again.
errors.injection: This reads like an instruction to the copilot, so it can't be saved. Write it as a fact about you.
errors.rejected: This memory can't be saved. Change the text and try again.
errors.rateLimited: You've reached your AI usage limit for now. Try again later.
errors.screeningUnavailable: This memory couldn't be checked right now. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.embeddingsFailed: This memory couldn't be saved right now. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.embeddingsUnavailable: Editing memories isn't available on this server. You can still forget them.
errors.unavailable: Memory is unavailable right now. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.failed: Couldn't save the memory. Try again.

forget.oneBody: The copilot will stop remembering this. You can't undo it.
forget.oneFailed: Couldn't forget the memory, so it's back in the list.
forget.allBody_one: The copilot will forget {{count}} saved memory. You can't undo it. To stop it saving new ones, turn memory off instead.
forget.allBody_other: The copilot will forget all {{count}} saved memories. You can't undo it. To stop it saving new ones, turn memory off instead.
forget.allFailed: Couldn't forget your memories. Try again.

oauth.title: Authorize access
oauth.requestingAccess: {{client}} wants to connect to your Knowtis notes.
oauth.redirectHostNotice: This application will receive access at {{host}}. Only continue if you trust it.

scopes.offlineAccess: Stay connected without signing in again

oauth.errorDescription: This authorization request is no longer valid. Start again from the application that sent you here.

decisionError.alreadyResolved: This request was already answered. Start the connection again from your MCP client.
decisionError.expired: This request expired. Start the connection again from your MCP client.
decisionError.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again, then restart the connection from your MCP client.
decisionError.emailNotVerified: Verify your email address to connect apps, then approve again.
decisionError.retryable: We couldn't complete your request. Please try again.

limit.notesTitle: You've reached the guest note limit
limit.notesDescription: Create a free account to save unlimited notes and access them from any device. Guest accounts are limited to {{maxNotes}} notes.
limit.aiTitle: AI requests limit reached for today
limit.aiDescription: Sign up for a free account to get more AI completions daily. Guest accounts are limited to {{maxAiRequests}} AI requests per day.
